body.methodNote: Derived: NDVI is not stored per land-cover class. Each bar is the district NDVI weighted by the area of the class in each district (9_2), not an NDVI measured over that class. Derived from 9_2: Σ (catchment area × district share) / Σ catchment area. One land-cover profile per district, constant over the record; cropland is withheld (a copy of grassland), so Grassland may include it.
body.title: District NDVI weighted by land-cover share (Dec 2025)
